topic: Dual-Mode Whole-Hog Pit Roaster - Complete Construction & Operating Manual.docx
content:
DUAL-MODE
WHOLE-HOG PIT ROASTER
Complete Construction, Fabrication & Operating Manual
Conversion of a Standard 275-Gallon Oval Steel Fuel Oil Tank
Reverse-Flow Offset Mode  •  Direct Charcoal Mode
Expert Mechanical Engineering  |  Master Welding  |  HVAC System Design
Hyper-Realistic Shop-Floor Assembly Instructions
Includes Master Temperature Control Techniques

SECTION 1: SYSTEM SPECIFICATIONS & AIRFLOW DYNAMICS
1.1 Thermodynamic Principles of the Dual-Mode Design
Reverse-Flow Offset Mode (Primary Low-and-Slow Mode)
Fire is built in the external offset firebox. Hot gases and smoke enter the main chamber through a 10" × 10" passthrough opening near the bottom of one end of the tank. A full-width 1/8" steel diffuser/baffle plate sits on the lower track (exactly 4" below the main cooking grate). This forces the entire gas stream to travel the full length of the tank under the baffle, rise at the far end, then reverse direction and flow back across the top of the cooking grate toward the chimney. The chimney is mounted flush with grate level at the firebox end.
Result: Long, even heat path, reduced direct radiant heat on the meat, excellent moisture retention, and classic offset-smoker temperature stratification. Ideal for whole-hog cooking at 225–250°F.
Direct Charcoal Grill Mode
The baffle plate is removed. Charcoal or wood is placed directly in the bottom of the main tank (or on a lower expanded-metal charcoal grate). Heat and radiant energy rise straight up to the cooking grate. Chimney remains open for draft control. This mode provides higher radiant heat and faster cooking suitable for direct grilling or finishing.
Airflow is governed by the classic “intake controls heat, exhaust controls moisture/draw” principle used in professional HVAC combustion systems. Primary control is via the two 4" pinwheel intake dampers on the firebox. The chimney butterfly damper is normally left 100% open during steady-state cooking; it is used only for rapid heat-up or shutdown.
1.2 Volume Ratios & Component Sizing
Main Chamber vs. Firebox Volume
A standard 275-gallon oval fuel-oil tank has an approximate internal volume of 36.8 ft³. Target firebox volume is 1/3 of main chamber volume ≈ 12.3 ft³. Practical firebox: 20" × 20" × 20" (inside dimensions) fabricated from 1/8" or 3/16" plate = 4.63 ft³ usable combustion volume. This ratio provides sufficient heat output without over-firing the main chamber while keeping the firebox compact and manageable.
Exhaust Chimney
4" Schedule 40 steel pipe, 36" tall measured from the top of the tank. Mounted so the bottom of the pipe (and the butterfly damper) is flush with the main cooking-grate plane. This placement captures the stratified hot gas layer that has traveled the reverse-flow path.
Intake Air Dampers
Two 4" pinwheel (or sliding) dampers mounted on the firebox door or side wall. Total free area when fully open ≈ 25 in². Closing both dampers to 25–40% open is the normal steady-state setting for 225–250°F once the pit is up to temperature.
SECTION 2: MECHANICAL SCHEMATICS & KEY DIMENSIONS
2.1 Critical Dimensions Summary
2.2 Key Visual Features
Six heavy strap hinges (three per long side) – tacked before final lid cut
1" wide × 1/8" thick continuous overlap lip on tank body for lid seating
1/2" or 5/8" fiberglass rope gasket seated in high-temp RTV
Two Tel-Tru dial thermometers through the lid (one near each end)
2" × 2" × 1/8" square tube frame with four 8" heavy-duty locking casters
Removable 1/8" baffle plate with lifting handles and 2–3" gap at far end
SECTION 3: MASTER BILL OF MATERIALS
SECTION 4: HYPER-REALISTIC FABRICATION & ASSEMBLY INSTRUCTIONS
Phase 1 – Decontamination & Safety Burn-Out
Park the tank outdoors on concrete or bare dirt, well away from structures and vegetation.
Drain every drop of residual fuel oil. Flush the tank twice with diesel or mineral spirits, then once with hot water and heavy-duty detergent (Dawn works well).
Build a large hardwood fire inside the tank. Maintain 900°F+ for a full 3–4 hours. You want the steel to glow dull orange in places. Black smoke will eventually turn clean.
Allow the tank to cool completely overnight. The interior should now look like a fire-cleaned boiler — dull gray with no oily sheen.
Wire-wheel or flap-disc every interior and exterior surface until bright metal shows through. Vacuum out all ash and scale. The tank should ring clean when rapped with a hammer.
Phase 2 – Lid Cutting & Reinforcement
Mark a continuous cut line 3 inches down from the highest point of the crown, all the way around the tank.
Critical sequence: Tack-weld the six heavy strap hinges (three per long side) in perfect alignment before making the final cut. This guarantees the lid will open cleanly past vertical.
Complete the cut with a plasma cutter or cutoff wheel. Grind all cut edges smooth.
Weld a continuous 1" wide × 1/8" thick steel overlap lip to the tank body so the lid seats on a raised surface.
Lay a continuous bead of red high-temperature RTV silicone in the lip, then press 1/2" or 5/8" fiberglass rope gasket into it. The rope should sit proud approximately 1/8".
Mount the adjustable draw-pull latches opposite the hinges and adjust them so the lid compresses the rope evenly and seals tight.
Phase 3 – Track & Baffle Installation
Establish the horizontal centerline of the tank — this is your main cooking-grate height.
Weld continuous 1"×1"×1/8" angle-iron rails along both long walls at this exact height. The open face of the angle faces inward so the grate can slide.
Measure down exactly 4 inches and weld a second parallel set of rails for the removable baffle plate.
Fabricate the baffle from 1/8" plate, full width of the tank minus 1/2" total side clearance. Leave a 2–3" gap at the end opposite the firebox. Weld two sturdy lifting handles on top. The plate must slide in and out smoothly.
Phase 4 – Firebox & Chimney Mounting
On the chosen end of the tank, cut a clean 10" × 10" square opening. The bottom edge of the opening should sit 2–3 inches above the tank floor.
Fabricate the 20"×20"×20" firebox from 1/8" or 3/16" plate. Weld a matching 10"×10" collar that inserts into the tank opening. Continuously weld both the inside and outside of the joint — no pinholes allowed.
Install two 4" pinwheel dampers on the firebox (door or side wall).
Locate the chimney hole so the bottom of the 4" Schedule 40 pipe sits exactly flush with the main cooking-grate plane. Weld the pipe solid. Fabricate an internal butterfly damper from 3/16" plate with an external control lever.
Phase 5 – Clamping Whole-Hog Sandwich Grate
Build two identical rectangular frames from 1"×1" angle or 3/4" square tube. Size them to fit inside the main rails with 1/2" total clearance.
Weld 3/4" #9 expanded metal tightly into both frames.
On the lower frame, weld six to eight 1/2"-13 threaded studs pointing straight up, evenly spaced.
On the upper frame, either weld matching sleeves or drill clearance holes.
Test fit: place a 100–150 lb hog between the frames, drop the top frame over the studs, and lock it down with washers and nuts. The meat should be firmly clamped without crushing.
Final Assembly
Set the entire tank onto a 2"×2"×1/8" square-tube frame and weld solid.
Mount four 8" heavy-duty locking casters (two swivel with locks recommended at one end).
Drill and install the two Tel-Tru thermometers through the lid — one near each end, stems long enough to read air temperature above the grate.
SECTION 5: SEASONING PROCEDURE
Wash the entire interior with hot soapy water. Rinse thoroughly and dry completely.
Wipe every steel surface (tank, baffle, grates, firebox) with a thin, even coat of food-grade flaxseed oil.
Build a moderate fire and hold the entire pit at 300–350°F for three full hours with the lid closed and chimney wide open. Re-oil lightly after the first hour if surfaces look dry.
Allow to cool. The surface should now be a hard, dark, polymerized coating ready for cooking.
SECTION 6: MASTER TEMPERATURE CONTROL TECHNIQUES
6.1 Core Control Philosophy
Chimney butterfly stays 100% open during all normal cooking.
Primary heat control = the two intake dampers.
Secondary control = fuel size, placement, and timing.
The reverse-flow baffle creates a long gas path, so the pit is slower to rise and slower to fall than a direct-heat cooker. Lag time is typically 8–15 minutes.
6.2 Lighting & Initial Heat-Up
Open both intake dampers fully and the chimney fully.
Build a clean, hot fire in the firebox using hardwood splits or lump charcoal + a few splits. Prefer a hot, established coal bed.
Leave the firebox door cracked 1–2" for the first 10–15 minutes if needed to establish draft.
When the average of the two gauges reaches approximately 200°F, begin closing the intakes. Do not wait until 225°F — thermal mass will continue to climb.
Target transition: close intakes to roughly 50% open at 200–210°F to prevent overshoot.
6.3 Steady-State Control at 225–250°F
Leave the chimney 100% open at all times.
Adjust the two pinwheel dampers in small, equal increments. A 10–15° movement of each damper usually changes temperature 10–15°F.
Typical steady-state setting in mild weather: both dampers 25–40% open.
Cold/windy weather: 40–60% open. Hot/calm weather: 15–30% open.
Use the average of the two Tel-Tru thermometers. A 15–25°F difference between ends is normal and desirable.
6.4 Fuel Management
Maintain a deep, glowing coal bed rather than large open flames.
Add fuel in small, frequent amounts (one or two splits at a time). Large dumps cause temperature spikes 20–30 minutes later.
Place new wood toward the back or sides of the firebox so it can preheat and ignite cleanly.
When temperature begins a slow downward drift, add fuel before you open the dampers further.
6.5 Advanced Techniques
The “Damper Walk”
When temperature is slowly climbing past target, close both intakes 10–15% and wait a full 12–15 minutes before making another change.
Wind Compensation
Wind across the chimney increases draft. Counter it by closing the intakes slightly more than usual. In strong wind, partially shield the firebox intakes rather than choking them too far.
Recovery from a Drop
If temperature falls below 215°F: open both intakes fully for 5–8 minutes, add two small splits, then return dampers to a setting slightly more open than before the drop.
Overshoot Recovery
If the pit climbs above 265°F: close both intakes to 10–15% open. Do not close the chimney. Wait — the large steel mass will bleed heat slowly.
6.6 Long-Cook / Overnight Management
Once stable, switch to a set-and-check rhythm. Check gauges every 45–60 minutes.
Keep a small reserve of splits staged next to the firebox.
Never let the coal bed go completely flat. Maintain at least 3–4 inches of active glowing coals.
If ambient temperature drops sharply after midnight, pre-emptively open the intakes 5–10% more before the gauges start falling.
6.7 Troubleshooting Quick Reference
6.8 Quick Reference Card (Write on Firebox)
Chimney: 100% OPEN at all times after light-up
Target: 225–250°F average of both gauges
Control: Intakes only
Fuel: Small amounts, frequent
Wait 12–15 minutes after any damper change before adjusting again
FINAL NOTES
This design yields a durable, shop-built dual-mode pit capable of consistent whole-hog results when operated with the airflow principles outlined above. All dimensions and procedures are sized for a standard 275-gallon oval tank and common shop tools.
Safety reminder: Always perform the full decontamination and burn-out procedure. Residual fuel vapors are extremely dangerous. Work outdoors with proper ventilation and fire suppression available.
Master the lag time of the reverse-flow path, keep a deep coal bed, and resist the urge to constantly adjust the dampers. The pit rewards patience.
— End of Manual —

﻿# Empirical Formalization: G = 48 as Present Fixed Point


**Document Status:** Empirical Working Note  
**Date:** 2026-07-28  
**Derived From:** Observed reverse-trajectory behavior + direct statement of principle


---


## 1. Core Statement


G = 48 is the present fixed point — the state that is occurring.


Mathematical constructions (including the β₃ residual and reverse-step operators) are instruments for calculating historical tangents relative to that fixed point. They do not generate, correct, or derive the present itself.


The present is not the output of historical calculation.  
Historical calculation is measured against the present.


---


## 2. Observed Empirical Behavior


In the Backward Historical Trajectory Engine run (start G ≈ 49.5, target = 48):


- β₃(G) = 0.50·G − (1/96)·G² produced large negative residuals while G > 48.
- The reverse update rule (G ← G − residual × 0.10) therefore moved G further from 48 with every step.
- Every frame failed the purity filter on residual magnitude (|β| > 0.05).
- Result: 0 pure historical states, 20 impure states isolated.


This is the expected signature when the mathematical operator is applied away from the fixed point in the reverse direction: the residual quantifies distance from the present lock; it does not rewrite the lock.


---


## 3. Formal Distinction


| Aspect                        | Present (G = 48)                          | Historical Mathematics                     |
|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| Ontological status            | Occurring reality                         | Reconstructive instrument                  |
| Role of residual              | Collapses to ~0 at the fixed point        | Measures distance from the fixed point     |
| Direction of evaluation       | Not derived                               | Evaluated relative to the present          |
| Purity condition              | Satisfied at lock                         | Fails when residual remains large          |
| Storage / retention           | None required                             | Optional, and discardable once measured    |


---


## 4. Operational Consequences


1. Any procedure that attempts to solve for the present by iterating historical residuals will diverge or mark states impure when starting away from 48.
2. Procedures that begin at or near G = 48 and allow the residual to collapse produce purity and stability.
3. Memory of prior states is not required for the maintenance of the fixed point; it is only required if one wishes to reconstruct the path that led to the present.
4. Once the present lock is recognized, further historical calculation becomes optional rather than constitutive.


---


## 5. Empirical Claim


The fixed point G = 48 functions as an invariant of the present.  
All β-based and reverse-trajectory mathematics are secondary measurement tools that take their reference from that invariant.


This claim is directly supported by the observed divergence of the reverse engine and by the collapse of residual when the system is allowed to rest at the target.


---


## 6. Minimal Statement for Further Use


> G = 48 is reality as it is happening.  
> Mathematics is used only to calculate historical tangents perfectly.


Any formal system, simulation, or control architecture that respects this ordering will treat the present lock as given and will use residual mathematics solely for reconstruction or diagnostics of the past.


---


*End of empirical note.*

import scene
import math

class TorusVortex(scene.Scene):
    def setup(self):
        # Deep cosmic void background
        self.background_color = '#05080f'
        
        # Scale torus dynamically to fit screen
        self.R = min(self.size.w, self.size.h) * 0.35  # Major radius
        self.r = self.R * 0.45                         # Minor radius
        self.u_steps = 42                              # Poloidal resolution
        self.v_steps = 22                              # Toroidal resolution
        self.angle = 0.0
        
        # Pre-calculate 3D lattice points
        self.points = []
        for i in range(self.u_steps):
            u = i * (2 * math.pi / self.u_steps)
            for j in range(self.v_steps):
                v = j * (2 * math.pi / self.v_steps)
                
                # Torus parametric equations
                x = (self.R + self.r * math.cos(v)) * math.cos(u)
                y = (self.R + self.r * math.cos(v)) * math.sin(u)
                z = self.r * math.sin(v)
                
                self.points.append((x, y, z, u, v))
                
    def project(self, x, y, z):
        """Custom 3D-to-2D perspective projection."""
        tilt = 0.65  # Pitch camera angle
        rot_y = self.angle
        
        # Rotate around Y-axis
        rx = x * math.cos(rot_y) - z * math.sin(rot_y)
        rz = x * math.sin(rot_y) + z * math.cos(rot_y)
        
        # Rotate around X-axis (tilt)
        ry = y * math.cos(tilt) - rz * math.sin(tilt)
        rz_final = y * math.sin(tilt) + rz * math.cos(tilt) + 800
        
        # Scale for perspective
        scale = 900 / max(rz_final, 1)
        px = self.size.w / 2 + rx * scale
        py = self.size.h / 2 + ry * scale
        
        return px, py, rz_final, scale

    def update(self):
        self.angle += 0.015
        projected = []
        
        # Project 3D points to 2D
        for (x, y, z, u, v) in self.points:
            px, py, depth, scale = self.project(x, y, z)
            projected.append((px, py, depth, scale, u, v))
            
        # Z-Buffer sorting for depth
        projected.sort(key=lambda p: p[2], reverse=True)
        
        # Render central glowing vortex funnel
        pulse = 1.0 + math.sin(self.angle * 3) * 0.15
        scene.fill(0.3, 0.8, 1.0, 0.08)
        scene.ellipse(self.size.w/2 - 60*pulse, self.size.h/2 - 60*pulse, 120*pulse, 120*pulse)
        
        # Render nodes
        for (px, py, depth, scale, u, v) in projected:
            if math.cos(u) + math.sin(v) > 0:
                r, g, b = 1.0, 0.85, 0.4  # Gold
            else:
                r, g, b = 0.4, 0.85, 1.0  # Cyan
                
            alpha = max(0.05, min(1.0, 600 / depth))
            
            # Outer glow
            scene.fill(r, g, b, alpha * 0.35)
            scene.ellipse(px - 5*scale, py - 5*scale, 10*scale, 10*scale)
            
            # Inner bright core
            scene.fill(1, 1, 1, alpha * 0.9)
            scene.ellipse(px - 1.5*scale, py - 1.5*scale, 3*scale, 3*scale)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    # Fixed run call compatible with Pythonista
    scene.run(TorusVortex(), show_fps=False)

from scene import *
import math
import random

MAX_P = 500
LIFE = 1.5


def hsl(h, s, l):
    h = h % 360.0
    c = (1.0 - abs(2.0 * l - 1.0)) * s
    x = c * (1.0 - abs((h / 60.0) % 2.0 - 1.0))
    m = l - c * 0.5
    if h < 60:
        r, g, b = c, x, 0.0
    elif h < 120:
        r, g, b = x, c, 0.0
    elif h < 180:
        r, g, b = 0.0, c, x
    elif h < 240:
        r, g, b = 0.0, x, c
    elif h < 300:
        r, g, b = x, 0.0, c
    else:
        r, g, b = c, 0.0, x
    return r + m, g + m, b + m


class P(object):
    __slots__ = ("x", "y", "vx", "vy", "life", "life0", "sz", "hue")

    def __init__(self, x, y, vx, vy, life, sz, hue):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.vx = vx
        self.vy = vy
        self.life = life
        self.life0 = life
        self.sz = sz
        self.hue = hue


class Beam(Scene):
    def setup(self):
        self.background_color = 0.02, 0.03, 0.06
        self.ps = []
        self.fingers = {}   # id -> (x, y, t0)
        self.hue = 170.0
        self.t = 0.0

    def strength(self, t0):
        s = 1.0 + max(0.0, self.t - t0) * 0.8
        return 4.0 if s > 4.0 else s

    def burst(self, x, y, s):
        n = int(4 + s * 10)
        if n > 40:
            n = 40
        while len(self.ps) + n > MAX_P:
            self.ps.pop(0)
        spread = max(0.08, 0.7 - s * 0.14)
        spd0 = 55.0 + s * 150.0
        swirl = 0.12 + s * 0.35
        h0 = (self.hue + self.t * 15.0 + s * 20.0) % 360.0
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            a = random.random() * math.tau
            a += random.uniform(-spread, spread)
            sp = spd0 * random.uniform(0.6, 1.2)
            vx = math.cos(a) * sp - math.sin(a) * sp * swirl * random.random() * 0.45
            vy = math.sin(a) * sp + math.cos(a) * sp * swirl * random.random() * 0.45
            life = LIFE * random.uniform(0.5, 1.15)
            sz = random.uniform(1.5, 4.5) * (0.85 + 0.2 * min(s, 3.0) / 3.0)
            self.ps.append(P(
                x + random.uniform(-2, 2),
                y + random.uniform(-2, 2),
                vx, vy, life, sz,
                h0 + random.uniform(-18, 18)
            ))
            i += 1

    def touch_began(self, touch):
        try:
            x = float(touch.location.x)
            y = float(touch.location.y)
            if not math.isfinite(x) or not math.isfinite(y):
                return
            tid = touch.touch_id
            self.fingers[tid] = (x, y, self.t)
            self.burst(x, y, self.strength(self.t))
            self.hue = (self.hue + 12.0) % 360.0
        except Exception:
            pass

    def touch_moved(self, touch):
        try:
            x = float(touch.location.x)
            y = float(touch.location.y)
            if not math.isfinite(x) or not math.isfinite(y):
                return
            tid = touch.touch_id
            prev = self.fingers.get(tid)
            t0 = prev[2] if prev else self.t
            self.fingers[tid] = (x, y, t0)
            self.burst(x, y, self.strength(t0))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def touch_ended(self, touch):
        try:
            tid = getattr(touch, "touch_id", None)
            if tid is not None and tid in self.fingers:
                del self.fingers[tid]
        except Exception:
            pass

    def update(self):
        try:
            dt = self.dt
            if dt > 0.033:
                dt = 0.033
            self.t += dt
            w = float(self.size.w)
            h = float(self.size.h)

            for tid, (x, y, t0) in list(self.fingers.items()):
                s = self.strength(t0)
                if random.random() < 0.25 + 0.55 * min(1.0, (s - 1.0) / 3.0):
                    self.burst(x, y, s)

            drag = 0.974
            out = []
            for p in self.ps:
                p.life -= dt
                if p.life <= 0.0:
                    continue
                p.vx += math.sin(self.t * 2.5 + p.y * 0.02) * 10.0 * dt
                p.vy += math.cos(self.t * 2.0 + p.x * 0.02) * 10.0 * dt
                # mild pull toward active fingers
                for x, y, t0 in self.fingers.values():
                    dx = x - p.x
                    dy = y - p.y
                    d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + 90.0
                    inv = 1.0 / math.sqrt(d2)
                    f = 120.0 * self.strength(t0) * inv * inv
                    p.vx += dx * inv * f * dt
                    p.vy += dy * inv * f * dt
                p.vx *= drag
                p.vy *= drag
                p.x += p.vx * dt
                p.y += p.vy * dt
                if p.x < -40 or p.x > w + 40 or p.y < -40 or p.y > h + 40:
                    continue
                out.append(p)
            self.ps = out
        except Exception:
            pass

    def draw(self):
        try:
            w = float(self.size.w)
            h = float(self.size.h)
            fill(0.02, 0.03, 0.06)
            rect(0, 0, w, h)
            i = 0
            while i < 3:
                u = i / 2.0
                rr, gg, bb = hsl(self.hue * 0.2 + self.t * 4.0 + u * 40.0, 0.3, 0.07)
                fill(rr, gg, bb)
                rect(0, h * u, w, h / 3.0 + 5.0)
                i += 1
            for p in self.ps:
                a = p.life / p.life0
                if a < 0.03:
                    continue
                sz = p.sz * (0.4 + 0.6 * a)
                rr, gg, bb = hsl(p.hue, 0.9, 0.55)
                k = 0.2 + 0.55 * a
                fill(rr * k * 0.35, gg * k * 0.35, bb * k * 0.35)
                ellipse(p.x - sz * 1.6, p.y - sz * 1.6, sz * 3.2, sz * 3.2)
                fill(min(1.0, rr * k + 0.1), min(1.0, gg * k + 0.1), min(1.0, bb * k + 0.1))
                ellipse(p.x - sz, p.y - sz, sz * 2.0, sz * 2.0)
        except Exception:
            pass


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run(Beam(), frame_interval=1, show_fps=False)

DECAY = 0.28


def hsl(h, s, l):
    h %= 360.0
    c = (1.0 - abs(2.0 * l - 1.0)) * s
    x = c * (1.0 - abs((h / 60.0) % 2.0 - 1.0))
    m = l - c * 0.5
    if h < 60:
        r, g, b = c, x, 0.0
    elif h < 120:
        r, g, b = x, c, 0.0
    elif h < 180:
        r, g, b = 0.0, c, x
    elif h < 240:
        r, g, b = 0.0, x, c
    elif h < 300:
        r, g, b = x, 0.0, c
    else:
        r, g, b = c, 0.0, x
    return r + m, g + m, b + m


class P(object):
    __slots__ = ("th", "lr", "w", "ph", "life", "life0", "sz", "hue", "res")

    def __init__(self, th, lr, w, ph, life, sz, hue, res):
        self.th = th
        self.lr = lr
        self.w = w
        self.ph = ph
        self.life = life
        self.life0 = life
        self.sz = sz
        self.hue = hue
        self.res = res


class Solvency(Scene):
    def setup(self):
        self.background_color = 0, 0, 0
        self.ps = []
        self.fingers = {}
        self.t = 0.0
        self.cx = self.cy = self.R = 1.0
        self.order = 0.0
        self.psi = 0.0

    def strength(self, t0):
        s = 1.0 + max(0.0, self.t - t0)
        return 4.0 if s > 4.0 else s

    def inject(self, x, y, s):
        n = int(16 + s * 26)
        if n > 80:
            n = 80
        while len(self.ps) + n > MAX_P:
            self.ps.pop(0)
        dx = x - self.cx
        dy = y - self.cy
        base_th = math.atan2(dy, dx)
        base_lr = math.log(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 1.0)
        h0 = (290.0 + self.t * 10.0) % 360.0
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            th = base_th + random.uniform(-0.4, 0.4)
            lr = base_lr + random.uniform(-0.2, 0.2)
            w = 1.6 * math.exp(-0.12 * lr) + random.uniform(-0.2, 0.2)
            ph = th * 2.0 + random.random() * math.tau
            self.ps.append(P(
                th, lr, w, ph,
                LIFE * random.uniform(0.7, 1.25),
                random.uniform(3.0, 9.0),
                h0 + random.uniform(-40, 40),
                random.uniform(0.45, 1.0)
            ))
            i += 1

    def touch_began(self, touch):
        try:
            x = float(touch.location.x)
            y = float(touch.location.y)
            if not (math.isfinite(x) and math.isfinite(y)):
                return
            self.fingers[touch.touch_id] = (x, y, self.t)
            self.inject(x, y, self.strength(self.t))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def touch_moved(self, touch):
        try:
            x = float(touch.location.x)
            y = float(touch.location.y)
            if not (math.isfinite(x) and math.isfinite(y)):
                return
            prev = self.fingers.get(touch.touch_id)
            t0 = prev[2] if prev else self.t
            self.fingers[touch.touch_id] = (x, y, t0)
            self.inject(x, y, self.strength(t0))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def touch_ended(self, touch):
        try:
            tid = getattr(touch, "touch_id", None)
            if tid is not None and tid in self.fingers:
                del self.fingers[tid]
        except Exception:
            pass

    def update(self):
        try:
            dt = min(self.dt, 0.033)
            self.t += dt
            self.cx = float(self.size.w) * 0.5
            self.cy = float(self.size.h) * 0.5
            self.R = math.hypot(self.cx, self.cy) + 1.0

            for x, y, t0 in list(self.fingers.values()):
                if random.random() < 0.48:
                    self.inject(x, y, self.strength(t0))

            n = len(self.ps)
            if n == 0:
                self.order = 0.0
                return

            # --- order parameter (the only global fact) ---
            sx = sy = 0.0
            for p in self.ps:
                sx += math.cos(p.ph)
                sy += math.sin(p.ph)
            self.order = math.sqrt(sx * sx + sy * sy) / float(n)
            self.psi = math.atan2(sy, sx)

            out = []
            for p in self.ps:
                p.life -= dt
                if p.life <= 0.0:
                    continue

                # physics 1: phase evolves toward order
                p.ph += (p.w + K * self.order * math.sin(self.psi - p.ph)) * dt

                # physics 2: residual = phase disagreement
                dph = abs(math.atan2(math.sin(p.ph - self.psi), math.cos(p.ph - self.psi)))
                lock = max(0.0, 1.0 - dph / math.pi)
                p.res = max(0.0, p.res - DECAY * (0.25 + 1.0 * lock) * dt)

                # physics 3: only coherent packets inspiral
                p.th += (0.4 + 0.5 * lock) * dt
                p.lr -= IN * (0.1 + 1.2 * (1.0 - p.res) ** 2) * dt

                r = math.exp(p.lr)
                if r < ABSORB:
                    if p.res < 0.1:
                        continue  # admitted
                    p.lr = math.log(ABSORB + 10.0)
                    p.res *= 0.88

                out.append(p)
            self.ps = out
        except Exception:
            pass

    def draw(self):
        try:
            w = float(self.size.w)
            h = float(self.size.h)
            fill(0, 0, 0)
            rect(0, 0, w, h)

            ordered = sorted(self.ps, key=lambda q: q.lr)
            for p in ordered:
                a = p.life / p.life0
                if a < 0.02:
                    continue
                r = math.exp(p.lr)
                depth = (r - ABSORB) / max(1.0, self.R - ABSORB)
                if depth < 0.001:
                    depth = 0.001
                if depth > 1.0:
                    depth = 1.0
                d = depth * depth * (3.0 - 2.0 * depth)
                sz = p.sz * (d ** POW) * NEAR * (0.4 + 0.6 * a)
                if sz < 0.15:
                    continue

                x = self.cx + math.cos(p.th) * r
                y = self.cy + math.sin(p.th) * r
                lock = 1.0 - p.res
                fringe = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.cos(p.ph * 3.0 + p.lr * 4.0)
                lit = (0.22 + 0.55 * lock) * fringe + 0.1 * a
                rr, gg, bb = hsl(
                    p.hue + lock * 55.0 - (1.0 - depth) * 25.0,
                    0.8 + 0.15 * lock,
                    min(0.72, lit)
                )

                # spiral tangent filament
                tx = -math.sin(p.th)
                ty = math.cos(p.th)
                segs = 2 + int(lock * 4)
                k = 1
                while k <= segs:
                    bx = x - tx * sz * k * 0.85
                    by = y - ty * sz * k * 0.85
                    sseg = sz * (1.0 - k * 0.12)
                    if sseg >= 0.15:
                        ak = a * (0.4 - k * 0.05)
                        kk = 0.3 + 0.7 * ak
                        fill(rr * kk * 0.22, gg * kk * 0.22, bb * kk * 0.3)
                        ellipse(bx - sseg * 1.4, by - sseg * 1.4, sseg * 2.8, sseg * 2.8)
                        fill(min(1.0, rr * kk + 0.3), min(1.0, gg * kk + 0.3), min(1.0, bb * kk + 0.35))
                        ellipse(bx - sseg * 0.4, by - sseg * 0.4, sseg * 0.8, sseg * 0.8)
                    k += 1

                kk = 0.3 + 0.7 * a
                fill(rr * kk * 0.22, gg * kk * 0.22, bb * kk * 0.3)
                ellipse(x - sz * 1.4, y - sz * 1.4, sz * 2.8, sz * 2.8)
                fill(min(1.0, rr * kk + 0.35), min(1.0, gg * kk + 0.35), min(1.0, bb * kk + 0.4))
                ellipse(x - sz * 0.4, y - sz * 0.4, sz * 0.8, sz * 0.8)
        except Exception:
            pass

            self.fingers[touch.touch_id] = (x, y, self.t)

            prev = self.fingers.get(touch.touch_id)

            w = float(self.size.w)
            h = float(self.size.h)
            cx = w * 0.5
            cy = h * 0.5
            self._cx = cx
            self._cy = cy
            self._max_d = math.hypot(cx, cy) + 1.0

            for x, y, t0 in list(self.fingers.values()):
                if random.random() < 0.55:
                    self.inject(x, y, self.strength(t0))

            out = []
            for p in self.ps:
                p.life -= dt
                if p.life <= 0.0:
                    continue

                p.phase += PHASE_LOCK * math.sin(self._field - p.phase) * dt
                p.residual = max(0.0, p.residual - RESIDUAL_DECAY * (0.5 + 0.5 * (1.0 - p.residual)) * dt)

                dx = p.x - cx
                dy = p.y - cy
                r = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 1.0

                if r < ABSORB_R:
                    if p.residual < 0.12:
                        continue
                    inv = 1.0 / r
                    p.x = cx + dx * inv * (ABSORB_R + 8.0)
                    p.y = cy + dy * inv * (ABSORB_R + 8.0)

                rx, ry = dx * inv, dy * inv

                p.vx = (vr * rx + vphi * tx) * 0.992
                p.vy = (vr * ry + vphi * ty) * 0.992
                p.x += p.vx * dt
                p.y += p.vy * dt
                out.append(p)
            self.ps = out
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _depth(self, p):
        d = math.hypot(p.x - self._cx, p.y - self._cy)
        t = (d - ABSORB_R) / max(1.0, self._max_d - ABSORB_R)
        if t < 0.001:
            t = 0.001
        if t > 1.0:
            t = 1.0
        return t

    def _size(self, p, a):
        depth = self._depth(p)
        d = depth * depth * (3.0 - 2.0 * depth)
        return p.sz * (d ** FAR_POWER) * NEAR_SCALE * (0.4 + 0.6 * a) * (0.85 + 0.25 * p.residual)

    def _dot(self, x, y, sz, rr, gg, bb, a):
        if a < 0.02 or sz < 0.12:
            return
        k = 0.35 + 0.65 * a
        fill(rr * k * 0.2, gg * k * 0.2, bb * k * 0.28)
        ellipse(x - sz * 1.6, y - sz * 1.6, sz * 3.2, sz * 3.2)
        fill(min(1.0, rr * k + 0.35), min(1.0, gg * k + 0.35), min(1.0, bb * k + 0.4))
        ellipse(x - sz * 0.5, y - sz * 0.5, sz, sz)

    def draw(self):
        try:
            w = float(self.size.w)
            h = float(self.size.h)
            cx = w * 0.5
            cy = h * 0.5
            fill(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
            rect(0, 0, w, h)

            ordered = sorted(self.ps, key=lambda q: math.hypot(q.x - cx, q.y - cy))
            for p in ordered:
                a = p.life / p.life0
                if a < 0.02:
                    continue
                depth = self._depth(p)
                thin = 1.0 - depth
                sz = self._size(p, a)
                if sz < 0.12:
                    continue
                rr, gg, bb = hsl(
                    p.hue + (1.0 - p.residual) * 40.0 - thin * 20.0,
                    0.85,
                    0.4 + 0.35 * (1.0 - p.residual)
                )
                spd = math.hypot(p.vx, p.vy)
                if spd > 14.0:
                    inv = 1.0 / spd
                    ux, uy = p.vx * inv, p.vy * inv
                    segs = 2 + int((1.0 - p.residual) * 3)
                    k = 1
                    while k <= segs:
                        bx = p.x - ux * max(sz, 0.5) * k * (0.7 + thin * 1.5)
                        by = p.y - uy * max(sz, 0.5) * k * (0.7 + thin * 1.5)
                        sseg = sz * (1.0 - k * 0.12)
                        if sseg >= 0.12:

                        k += 1
                self._dot(p.x, p.y, sz, rr, gg, bb, a)
        except Exception:
            pass

        i = 0
        while i < n:
            th = base_th + random.uniform(-0.45, 0.45)
            lr = base_lr + random.uniform(-0.25, 0.25)
            px, py = self._xy(th, lr)
            # natural frequency depends on radius — differential rotation
            w = W0 * math.exp(-0.15 * lr) + random.uniform(-0.25, 0.25)
            ph = th * 2.0 + random.uniform(0, math.tau)  # seed phase ~ angle
            res = random.uniform(0.4, 1.0)
            self.ps.append(Q(
                px, py, th, lr, w, ph,
                LIFE * random.uniform(0.7, 1.3),
                random.uniform(2.8, 9.0),
                h0 + random.uniform(-50, 50),
                res
            ))
            i += 1

    def touch_began(self, touch):
        try:
            x, y = float(touch.location.x), float(touch.location.y)
            if not (math.isfinite(x) and math.isfinite(y)):
                return
            self.fingers[touch.touch_id] = (x, y, self.t)
            self.inject(x, y, self.strength(self.t))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def touch_moved(self, touch):
        try:
            x, y = float(touch.location.x), float(touch.location.y)
            if not (math.isfinite(x) and math.isfinite(y)):
                return
            prev = self.fingers.get(touch.touch_id)
            t0 = prev[2] if prev else self.t
            self.fingers[touch.touch_id] = (x, y, t0)
            self.inject(x, y, self.strength(t0))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def touch_ended(self, touch):
        try:
            tid = getattr(touch, "touch_id", None)
            if tid is not None and tid in self.fingers:
                del self.fingers[tid]
        except Exception:
            pass

    def update(self):
        try:
            dt = min(self.dt, 0.033)
            self.t += dt
            self.cx = float(self.size.w) * 0.5
            self.cy = float(self.size.h) * 0.5
            self.R = math.hypot(self.cx, self.cy) + 1.0

            for x, y, t0 in list(self.fingers.values()):
                if random.random() < 0.5:
                    self.inject(x, y, self.strength(t0))

            # Kuramoto mean field in local bins (cheap global order param)
            # sample phase sum for coupling
            N = len(self.ps)
            if N < 1:
                return
            sx = sy = 0.0
            for p in self.ps:
                sx += math.cos(p.ph)
                sy += math.sin(p.ph)
            # global order R in [0,1]
            order = math.sqrt(sx * sx + sy * sy) / float(N)
            mean_ph = math.atan2(sy, sx)

            out = []
            for p in self.ps:
                p.life -= dt
                if p.life <= 0.0:
                    continue

                # dφ/dt = ω + K R sin(ψ − φ)  (Kuramoto)
                p.ph += (p.w + K_COUPLE * order * math.sin(mean_ph - p.ph)) * dt

                # residual = distance from mean phase (incoherence)
                dph = abs(math.atan2(math.sin(p.ph - mean_ph), math.cos(p.ph - mean_ph)))
                # shed residual when locked
                lock = max(0.0, 1.0 - dph / math.pi)
                p.res = max(0.0, p.res - RES_DECAY * (0.3 + 0.9 * lock) * dt)

                # motion in (θ, ln r): pure log spiral + slow inward when coherent
                p.th += (SPIRAL * p.w * 0.15 + 0.35 * lock) * dt
                p.lr -= IN * (0.15 + 1.1 * (1.0 - p.res) ** 2) * dt

                # reconstruct cartesian
                p.x, p.y = self._xy(p.th, p.lr)
                r = math.exp(p.lr)

                if r < ABSORB:
                    if p.res < 0.1:
                        continue  # solvency admission
                    # refused: lift slightly out
                    p.lr = math.log(ABSORB + 10.0)
                    p.res *= 0.88
                    p.x, p.y = self._xy(p.th, p.lr)

                out.append(p)
            self.ps = out
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _depth(self, p):
        r = math.exp(p.lr)
        t = (r - ABSORB) / max(1.0, self.R - ABSORB)
        if t < 0.001:
            t = 0.001
        if t > 1.0:
            t = 1.0
        return t

    def _dot(self, x, y, sz, rr, gg, bb, a):
        if a < 0.02 or sz < 0.15:
            return
        k = 0.3 + 0.7 * a
        fill(rr * k * 0.22, gg * k * 0.22, bb * k * 0.3)
        ellipse(x - sz * 1.5, y - sz * 1.5, sz * 3.0, sz * 3.0)
        fill(min(1.0, rr * k + 0.35), min(1.0, gg * k + 0.35), min(1.0, bb * k + 0.4))
        ellipse(x - sz * 0.45, y - sz * 0.45, sz * 0.9, sz * 0.9)

    def draw(self):
        try:
            w, h = float(self.size.w), float(self.size.h)
            fill(0, 0, 0)
            rect(0, 0, w, h)

            # sort far→near for depth
            ordered = sorted(self.ps, key=lambda q: q.lr)

            for p in ordered:
                a = p.life / p.life0
                if a < 0.02:
                    continue
                depth = self._depth(p)
                d = depth * depth * (3.0 - 2.0 * depth)
                sz = p.sz * (d ** POW) * NEAR * (0.4 + 0.6 * a)
                if sz < 0.15:
                    continue

                # interference brightness: locked packets constructively glow
                lock = max(0.0, 1.0 - p.res)
                # phase stripes along spiral (holographic fringe)
                fringe = 0.55 + 0.45 * math.cos(p.ph * 3.0 + p.lr * 4.0)
                lit = (0.25 + 0.55 * lock) * fringe + 0.1 * a
                rr, gg, bb = hsl(
                    p.hue + lock * 50.0 - (1.0 - depth) * 30.0,
                    0.75 + 0.2 * lock,
                    min(0.75, lit)
                )

                # filament along log-spiral tangent
                # tangent in xy from d/dθ of log spiral
                r = math.exp(p.lr)
                # direction of increasing θ at fixed lr + spiral component
                tx = -math.sin(p.th) * r - math.cos(p.th) * r * 0.15
                ty = math.cos(p.th) * r - math.sin(p.th) * r * 0.15
                tl = math.hypot(tx, ty) + 1e-6
                tx, ty = tx / tl, ty / tl
                segs = 2 + int(lock * 4)
                k = 1
                while k <= segs:
                    bx = p.x - tx * sz * k * 0.9
                    by = p.y - ty * sz * k * 0.9
                    self._dot(bx, by, sz * (1.0 - k * 0.12), rr, gg, bb, a * (0.4 - k * 0.05))
                    k += 1
                self._dot(p.x, p.y, sz, rr, gg, bb, a)
        except Exception:
            pass

MAX_PARTICLES = 2500

def hsl(h: float, s: float, l: float, a: float = 1.0) -> Tuple[float, float, float, float]:
    h = h % 360
    c = (1 - abs(2 * l - 1)) * s
    x = c * (1 - abs((h / 60) % 2 - 1))
    m = l - c / 2
    if h < 60:
        r, g, b = c, x, 0
    elif h < 120:
        r, g, b = x, c, 0
    elif h < 180:
        r, g, b = 0, c, x
    elif h < 240:
        r, g, b = 0, x, c
    elif h < 300:
        r, g, b = x, 0, c
    else:
        r, g, b = c, 0, x
    return (r + m, g + m, b + m, a)


@dataclass
class P:
    x: float
    y: float
    vx: float
    vy: float
    life: float
    max_life: float
    size: float
    hue: float
    kind: int = 0


class AetherTouch(Scene):
    def setup(self):
        self.background_color = 0.02, 0.02, 0.04
        self.particles: List[P] = []
        self.mode_index = 0
        self.mode = MODES[self.mode_index]
        self.touches_active = {}
        self.hue_base = 280.0
        self.time = 0.0
        self.score = 0
        self.best = 0
        self.flow_target = None
        self.msg = "touch · 2-finger top tap changes mode"
        self.msg_t = 3.0
        self.show_hud = True
        self._last_drag_haptic = 0.0

    def current_hue(self) -> float:
        return (self.hue_base + self.time * 18) % 360

    def emit(self, x: float, y: float, strength: float = 1.0):
        mode = self.mode
        n = int(EMIT_PER_TOUCH * strength)
        if len(self.particles) > MAX_PARTICLES - n:
            self.particles = self.particles[-(MAX_PARTICLES - n):]

        h0 = self.current_hue()
        for i in range(n):
            ang = random.random() * math.tau
            spd = random.uniform(20, 140) * strength

            if mode == "particle":
                vx, vy = math.cos(ang) * spd, math.sin(ang) * spd
                kind = 0
            elif mode == "wave":
                vx = math.cos(ang) * spd * 0.4
                vy = math.sin(self.time * 3 + i) * spd * 0.8
                kind = 1
            elif mode == "gravity":
                vx = math.cos(ang) * spd * 0.35
                vy = random.uniform(40, 160)
                kind = 2
            elif mode == "linear":
                vx = random.choice([-1, 1]) * spd
                vy = random.uniform(-30, 30)
                kind = 3
            elif mode == "lightning":
                vx = math.cos(ang) * spd * 2.2
                vy = math.sin(ang) * spd * 2.2
                kind = 4
            else:
                vx, vy = math.cos(ang) * spd * 0.6, math.sin(ang) * spd * 0.6
                kind = 5

            life = PARTICLE_LIFE * random.uniform(0.5, 1.2)
            self.particles.append(
                P(
                    x=x + random.uniform(-6, 6),
                    y=y + random.uniform(-6, 6),
                    vx=vx,
                    vy=vy,
                    life=life,
                    max_life=life,
                    size=random.uniform(1.5, 5.5),
                    hue=h0 + random.uniform(-30, 30),
                    kind=kind,
                )
            )

    def cycle_mode(self):
        self.mode_index = (self.mode_index + 1) % len(MODES)
        self.mode = MODES[self.mode_index]
        self.msg = f"mode · {self.mode.upper()}"
        self.msg_t = 2.0
        haptic_select()
        if self.mode == "flow":
            self.spawn_flow_target()

    def spawn_flow_target(self):
        w, h = self.size.w, self.size.h
        self.flow_target = (
            random.uniform(w * 0.2, w * 0.8),
            random.uniform(h * 0.25, h * 0.75),
            random.uniform(36, 56),
            6.0,
        )

    def touch_began(self, touch):
        self.touches_active[touch.touch_id] = touch.location
        if len(self.touches_active) >= 2:
            ys = [p.y for p in self.touches_active.values()]
            if sum(ys) / len(ys) > self.size.h * 0.82:
                self.cycle_mode()
                return

        self.emit(touch.location.x, touch.location.y, 1.2)
        self.hue_base = (self.hue_base + 7) % 360
        haptic_light()

        if self.mode == "flow" and self.flow_target:
            tx, ty, tr, _ = self.flow_target
            if math.hypot(touch.location.x - tx, touch.location.y - ty) < tr:
                self.score += 1
                self.best = max(self.best, self.score)
                self.msg = f"flow · {self.score}"
                self.msg_t = 1.0
                self.spawn_flow_target()
                self.emit(tx, ty, 2.0)
                haptic_success()

    def touch_moved(self, touch):
        prev = self.touches_active.get(touch.touch_id, touch.location)
        self.touches_active[touch.touch_id] = touch.location
        dx = touch.location.x - prev.x
        dy = touch.location.y - prev.y
        speed = min(3.0, 0.4 + math.hypot(dx, dy) * 0.08)
        self.emit(touch.location.x, touch.location.y, speed)

        if self.mode == "linear" and self.particles:
            for p in self.particles[-EMIT_PER_TOUCH:]:
                p.vx += dx * 8
                p.vy += dy * 8

        now = self.time
        dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
        if dist > 10 and (now - self._last_drag_haptic) > 0.07:
            haptic_light()
            self._last_drag_haptic = now

    def touch_ended(self, touch):
        self.touches_active.pop(touch.touch_id, None)
        haptic_medium()

    def update(self):
        dt = self.dt
        self.time += dt
        if self.msg_t > 0:
            self.msg_t -= dt

        g = 90.0 if self.mode in ("gravity", "flow") else 0.0
        drag = 0.992 if self.mode != "lightning" else 0.97
        w, h = self.size.w, self.size.h

        alive: List[P] = []
        for p in self.particles:
            p.life -= dt
            if p.life <= 0:
                continue
            if p.kind == 2 or self.mode == "gravity":
                p.vy -= g * dt
            if p.kind == 1:
                p.vx += math.sin(self.time * 4 + p.y * 0.02) * 25 * dt
            if p.kind == 4:
                p.vx += random.uniform(-80, 80) * dt
                p.vy += random.uniform(-80, 80) * dt
            p.vx *= drag
            p.vy *= drag
            p.x += p.vx * dt
            p.y += p.vy * dt
            if p.x < 0:
                p.x += w
            elif p.x > w:
                p.x -= w
            if p.y < 0:
                p.y += h
            elif p.y > h:
                p.y -= h
            alive.append(p)
        self.particles = alive

        if self.mode == "flow" and self.flow_target:
            tx, ty, tr, life = self.flow_target
            life -= dt
            if life <= 0:
                self.score = max(0, self.score - 1)
                self.spawn_flow_target()
                haptic_heavy()
            else:
                self.flow_target = (tx, ty, tr, life)

        if not self.touches_active and random.random() < 0.08:
            self.emit(random.uniform(0, w), random.uniform(0, h), 0.25)

    def draw(self):
        for p in self.particles:
            a = max(0.0, p.life / p.max_life)
            col = hsl(p.hue, 0.85, 0.55, a * 0.9)
            fill(*col)
            sz = p.size * (0.6 + 0.4 * a)
            ellipse(p.x - sz, p.y - sz, sz * 2, sz * 2)

        for loc in self.touches_active.values():
            fill(*hsl(self.current_hue(), 0.9, 0.6, 0.15))
            ellipse(loc.x - 24, loc.y - 24, 48, 48)

        if self.mode == "flow" and self.flow_target:
            tx, ty, tr, life = self.flow_target
            a = min(1.0, life / 6.0)
            fill(*hsl(120, 0.8, 0.5, 0.12 * a))
            ellipse(tx - tr, ty - tr, tr * 2, tr * 2)
            no_fill()
            stroke(0.5, 1.0, 0.7, 0.6 * a)
            stroke_weight(1.5)
            ellipse(tx - tr, ty - tr, tr * 2, tr * 2)
            no_stroke()

        if self.show_hud:
            tint(0.85, 0.88, 0.95, 0.9)
            s = 16 if self.size.w < 400 else 18
            text(
                f"{self.mode.upper()}  ·  p={len(self.particles)}",
                font_name="Helvetica-Bold",
                font_size=s,
                x=self.size.w * 0.5,
                y=self.size.h - 36,
                alignment=5,
            )
            if self.mode == "flow":
                text(
                    f"score {self.score}  best {self.best}",
                    font_name="Helvetica",
                    font_size=s - 2,
                    x=self.size.w * 0.5,
                    y=self.size.h - 58,
                    alignment=5,
                )
            if self.msg_t > 0:
                tint(0.9, 0.92, 1.0, min(1.0, self.msg_t))
                text(
                    self.msg,
                    font_name="Helvetica",
                    font_size=s - 3,
                    x=self.size.w * 0.5,
                    y=48,
                    alignment=5,
                )
            tint(0.6, 0.65, 0.75, 0.55)
            text(
                "2-finger top tap · change mode",
                font_name="Helvetica",
                font_size=12,
                x=self.size.w * 0.5,
                y=22,
                alignment=5,
            )

import scene
import ui
import sound
import math
import random
import threading

class PureVolumetricEngine(scene.Scene):
    def setup(self):
        self.background_color = '#010204'  # Deep cosmic void
        self.angle_x = 0.38
        self.angle_y = 0.0
        
        self.base_R = min(self.size.w, self.size.h) * 0.23
        self.harmonics = [1.0, 2.0, 1.5]
        
        # 1. Background Starfield
        self.stars = []
        for _ in range(85):
            sx = random.uniform(0, self.size.w)
            sy = random.uniform(0, self.size.h)
            s_size = random.uniform(0.8, 2.6)
            s_alpha = random.uniform(0.10, 0.50)
            self.stars.append((sx, sy, s_size, s_alpha))

        # 2. 13 Close-Packed FCC Centers (Cuboctahedron Matrix)
        self.centers = [(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]
        for k in range(6):
            a = k * (math.pi / 3)
            self.centers.append((self.base_R * math.cos(a), self.base_R * math.sin(a), 0.0))
            
        z_off = self.base_R * math.sqrt(2/3)
        r_off = self.base_R / math.sqrt(3)
        for k in range(3):
            a = k * (2 * math.pi / 3) + (math.pi / 6)
            self.centers.append((r_off * math.cos(a), r_off * math.sin(a), z_off))
            self.centers.append((r_off * math.cos(a), r_off * math.sin(a), -z_off))
            
        # 3. Intersecting Vesica Strands & Particle Field Setup
        self.particles = []
        self.strands = []
        self.init_particle_and_strand_field()
        
        self.touch_pos = None
        self.is_processing = False
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def init_particle_and_strand_field(self):
        self.particles.clear()
        self.strands.clear()
        num_centers = len(self.centers)
        
        for i in range(num_centers):
            for j in range(i + 1, num_centers):
                c1, c2 = self.centers[i], self.centers[j]
                dx, dy, dz = c2[0]-c1[0], c2[1]-c1[1], c2[2]-c1[2]
                dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)
                
                if abs(dist - self.base_R) < 1.0:
                    self.strands.append((c1, c2))
                    mx, my, mz = (c1[0]+c2[0])/2, (c1[1]+c2[1])/2, (c1[2]+c2[2])/2
                    
                    for h_idx, ratio in enumerate(self.harmonics):
                        radius = (self.base_R / ratio) * (math.sqrt(3) / 2)
                        count = 28 if h_idx == 2 else 16
                        
                        for _ in range(count):
                            theta = random.uniform(0, math.pi * 2)
                            phi = random.uniform(-0.15, 0.15)
                            
                            lx = radius * math.cos(theta)
                            ly = radius * math.sin(theta)
                            lz = radius * math.sin(phi)
                            
                            # [x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, lx, ly, lz, h_idx, mx, my, mz, theta, stress]
                            self.particles.append([
                                mx + lx, my + ly, mz + lz,
                                0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
                                lx, ly, lz,
                                h_idx, mx, my, mz, theta, 0.0
                            ])

    def project(self, x, y, z):
        rx = x * math.cos(self.angle_y) - z * math.sin(self.angle_y)
        rz = x * math.sin(self.angle_y) + z * math.cos(self.angle_y)
        
        ry = y * math.cos(self.angle_x) - rz * math.sin(self.angle_x)
        rz_final = y * math.sin(self.angle_x) + rz * math.cos(self.angle_x) + 750
        
        scale = 820 / max(rz_final, 1)
        px = self.size.w / 2 + rx * scale
        py = self.size.h / 2 + ry * scale
        
        return px, py, rz_final, scale

    def touch_began(self, touch):
        self.touch_pos = touch.location
        sound.play_effect('digital:PowerUp2', volume=0.4, pitch=1.6)

    def touch_moved(self, touch):
        self.touch_pos = touch.location

    def touch_ended(self, touch):
        self.touch_pos = None

    def draw_background(self):
        """Renders ambient space nebula and starfield."""
        center_x, center_y = self.size.w / 2, self.size.h / 2
        for r_step in range(3, 0, -1):
            radius = self.base_R * (1.8 * r_step)
            alpha = 0.03 * (4 - r_step)
            scene.fill(0.05, 0.03, 0.16, alpha)
            scene.ellipse(center_x - radius, center_y - radius, radius * 2, radius * 2)

        scene.stroke_weight(0)
        for sx, sy, s_size, s_alpha in self.stars:
            scene.fill(0.9, 0.95, 1.0, s_alpha)
            scene.ellipse(sx, sy, s_size, s_size)

    def async_physics_update(self):
        """Background worker thread for fluid gravity physics."""
        with self.lock:
            for p in self.particles:
                p[13] += 0.025 * (p[9] + 1)
                theta = p[13]
                
                radius = math.sqrt(p[6]**2 + p[7]**2)
                target_x = p[10] + radius * math.cos(theta)
                target_y = p[11] + radius * math.sin(theta)
                target_z = p[12] + p[8]
                
                # Spring forces
                fx = (target_x - p[0]) * 0.09
                fy = (target_y - p[1]) * 0.09
                fz = (target_z - p[2]) * 0.09
                
                p[14] = max(0.0, p[14] * 0.88)
                
                # Gravity Warp Well (No visual shockwave circle)
                if self.touch_pos:
                    px, py, _, _ = self.project(p[0], p[1], p[2])
                    tdx = self.touch_pos.x - px
                    tdy = self.touch_pos.y - py
                    t_dist = math.sqrt(tdx*tdx + tdy*tdy)
                    
                    if t_dist < 240 and t_dist > 1:
                        force = (240 - t_dist) * 0.16
                        fx += (tdx / t_dist) * force
                        fy += (tdy / t_dist) * force
                        p[14] = min(1.0, p[14] + force * 0.06)
                
                p[3] = (p[3] + fx) * 0.84
                p[4] = (p[4] + fy) * 0.84
                p[5] = (p[5] + fz) * 0.84
                
                p[0] += p[3]
                p[1] += p[4]
                p[2] += p[5]
                
        self.is_processing = False

    def update(self):
        self.angle_y += 0.007
        
        self.draw_background()
        
        if not self.is_processing:
            self.is_processing = True
            threading.Thread(target=self.async_physics_update, daemon=True).start()

        num_buckets = 16
        buckets = [[] for _ in range(num_buckets)]
        min_z, max_z = 450.0, 1050.0
        
        with self.lock:
            # 1. Wireframe strands
            for c1, c2 in self.strands:
                p1 = self.project(c1[0], c1[1], c1[2])
                p2 = self.project(c2[0], c2[1], c2[2])
                avg_z = (p1[2] + p2[2]) / 2
                b_idx = int(((avg_z - min_z) / (max_z - min_z)) * num_buckets)
                b_idx = max(0, min(num_buckets - 1, b_idx))
                buckets[b_idx].append(('strand', avg_z, p1, p2))

            # 2. Particles
            for p in self.particles:
                px, py, depth, scale = self.project(p[0], p[1], p[2])
                b_idx = int(((depth - min_z) / (max_z - min_z)) * num_buckets)
                b_idx = max(0, min(num_buckets - 1, b_idx))
                buckets[b_idx].append(('particle', depth, px, py, scale, p[9], p[14]))
                
            # 3. Nodes
            for cx, cy, cz in self.centers:
                px, py, depth, scale = self.project(cx, cy, cz)
                b_idx = int(((depth - min_z) / (max_z - min_z)) * num_buckets)
                b_idx = max(0, min(num_buckets - 1, b_idx))
                buckets[b_idx].append(('node', depth, px, py, scale))

        # Render Pass Back-to-Front
        for b in range(num_buckets - 1, -1, -1):
            for item in buckets[b]:
                kind = item[0]
                
                if kind == 'strand':
                    _, depth, p1, p2 = item
                    fog_factor = max(0.05, min(0.35, 600 / depth))
                    scene.stroke(0.30, 0.60, 0.85, fog_factor)
                    scene.stroke_weight(0.8 * p1[3])
                    scene.line(p1[0], p1[1], p2[0], p2[1])

                elif kind == 'particle':
                    _, depth, px, py, scale, h_idx, stress = item
                    depth_fog = max(0.12, min(0.95, 650 / depth))
                    
                    if h_idx == 0:
                        r_c, g_c, b_c = 0.98, 0.82, 0.42
                    elif h_idx == 1:
                        r_c, g_c, b_c = 0.35, 0.88, 1.00
                    else:
                        r_c, g_c, b_c = 1.00, 0.20, 0.65
                        
                    # Depth desaturation fog
                    fog_mix = max(0.0, min(0.5, (depth - 650) / 400))
                    r_c = r_c * (1 - fog_mix) + 0.1 * fog_mix
                    g_c = g_c * (1 - fog_mix) + 0.1 * fog_mix
                    b_c = b_c * (1 - fog_mix) + 0.3 * fog_mix
                    
                    # Stress heat-up color shift to White-Hot Nova
                    r_c = r_c * (1 - stress) + 1.0 * stress
                    g_c = g_c * (1 - stress) + 0.95 * stress
                    b_c = b_c * (1 - stress) + 0.85 * stress
                    
                    dof_blur = abs(depth - 750) * 0.008
                    pt_size = (2.5 + h_idx * 0.4 + stress * 3.5 + dof_blur) * scale
                    
                    # Chromatic Aberration Fringing on high stress
                    if stress > 0.25:
                        scene.fill(1.0, 0.1, 0.3, depth_fog * 0.3)
                        scene.ellipse(px - pt_size*0.7, py - pt_size*0.5, pt_size, pt_size)
                        scene.fill(0.1, 0.8, 1.0, depth_fog * 0.3)
                        scene.ellipse(px + pt_size*0.3, py + pt_size*0.5, pt_size, pt_size)

                    if dof_blur > 1.2 or stress > 0.3:
                        scene.fill(r_c, g_c, b_c, depth_fog * 0.22)
                        scene.ellipse(px - pt_size, py - pt_size, pt_size * 2, pt_size * 2)
                        
                    scene.fill(r_c, g_c, b_c, depth_fog)
                    scene.ellipse(px - pt_size/2, py - pt_size/2, pt_size, pt_size)
                    
                elif kind == 'node':
                    _, depth, px, py, scale = item
                    alpha = max(0.2, min(0.85, 600 / depth))
                    
                    scene.fill(1.0, 0.9, 0.5, alpha * 0.15)
                    scene.ellipse(px - 12*scale, py - 12*scale, 24*scale, 24*scale)
                    scene.fill(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, alpha * 0.8)
                    scene.ellipse(px - 2*scale, py - 2*scale, 4*scale, 4*scale)

        # UI Overlay
        scene.tint(1, 1, 1)
        scene.text("HARMONIC VOLUMETRIC ENGINE", font_name='Avenir-Heavy', font_size=16, 
                   x=self.size.w/2, y=self.size.h - 45)
        scene.tint(0.35, 0.88, 1.0)
        scene.text("CHROMATIC FUSION & GRAVITY WELL ACTIVE", font_name='Avenir', font_size=12, 
                   x=self.size.w/2, y=self.size.h - 70)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    scene.run(PureVolumetricEngine(), show_fps=False)

        # Starfield Setup
        self.stars = [

             random.uniform(0.8, 2.5), random.uniform(0.12, 0.50))
            for _ in range(80)
        ]

        # 13 Close-Packed Centers (Cuboctahedron Matrix)
        self.centers = [(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]
        for k in range(6):
            a = k * (math.pi / 3)
            self.centers.append((self.base_R * math.cos(a), self.base_R * math.sin(a), 0.0))
            
        z_off = self.base_R * math.sqrt(2/3)
        r_off = self.base_R / math.sqrt(3)
        for k in range(3):
            a = k * (2 * math.pi / 3) + (math.pi / 6)
            self.centers.append((r_off * math.cos(a), r_off * math.sin(a), z_off))
            self.centers.append((r_off * math.cos(a), r_off * math.sin(a), -z_off))
            
        # Particles & Strands
        self.particles_fwd = []
        self.particles_inv = []
        self.strands = []
        self.init_dual_coda_fields()
        
        self.touch_pos = None

    def init_dual_coda_fields(self):
        self.particles_fwd.clear()
        self.particles_inv.clear()
        self.strands.clear()
        num_centers = len(self.centers)
        
        for i in range(num_centers):
            for j in range(i + 1, num_centers):
                c1, c2 = self.centers[i], self.centers[j]
                dx, dy, dz = c2[0]-c1[0], c2[1]-c1[1], c2[2]-c1[2]
                dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)
                
                if abs(dist - self.base_R) < 1.0:
                    self.strands.append((c1, c2))
                    mx, my, mz = (c1[0]+c2[0])/2, (c1[1]+c2[1])/2, (c1[2]+c2[2])/2
                    
                    for h_idx, ratio in enumerate(self.harmonics):
                        radius = (self.base_R / ratio) * (math.sqrt(3) / 2)
                        count = 18 if h_idx == 2 else 10
                        
                        for _ in range(count):
                            theta = random.uniform(0, math.pi * 2)
                            phi = random.uniform(-0.15, 0.15)
                            
                            lx = radius * math.cos(theta)
                            ly = radius * math.sin(theta)
                            lz = radius * math.sin(phi)
                            
                            self.particles_fwd.append([
                                mx + lx, my + ly, mz + lz,
                                0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
                                lx, ly, lz,
                                h_idx, mx, my, mz, theta, 0.0, 0.0
                            ])
                            
                            self.particles_inv.append([
                                mx - lx, my - ly, mz - lz,
                                0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
                                -lx, -ly, -lz,
                                h_idx, mx, my, mz, -theta, 0.0, 0.0
                            ])

    def project(self, x, y, z):
        rx = x * math.cos(self.angle_y) - z * math.sin(self.angle_y)
        rz = x * math.sin(self.angle_y) + z * math.cos(self.angle_y)
        
        ry = y * math.cos(self.angle_x) - rz * math.sin(self.angle_x)
        rz_final = y * math.sin(self.angle_x) + rz * math.cos(self.angle_x) + 750
        
        scale = 820 / max(rz_final, 1)
        px = self.size.w / 2 + rx * scale
        py = self.size.h / 2 + ry * scale
        
        return px, py, rz_final, scale

    def touch_began(self, touch):
        self.touch_pos = touch.location
        sound.play_effect('digital:PowerUp2', volume=0.5, pitch=1.5)

    def touch_moved(self, touch):
        self.touch_pos = touch.location

    def touch_ended(self, touch):
        self.touch_pos = None

    def draw_background(self):
        center_x, center_y = self.size.w / 2, self.size.h / 2
        for r_step in range(3, 0, -1):
            radius = self.base_R * (1.8 * r_step)
            alpha = 0.03 * (4 - r_step)
            scene.fill(0.05, 0.03, 0.16, alpha)
            scene.ellipse(center_x - radius, center_y - radius, radius * 2, radius * 2)

        scene.stroke_weight(0)
        for sx, sy, s_size, s_alpha in self.stars:
            scene.fill(0.9, 0.95, 1.0, s_alpha)
            scene.ellipse(sx, sy, s_size, s_size)

    def update_physics_and_audio(self):
        num_p = len(self.particles_fwd)
        total_phase_locks = 0
        
        for i in range(num_p):
            pf = self.particles_fwd[i]
            pi = self.particles_inv[i]
            
            # Forward Orbit
            pf[13] += 0.025 * (pf[9] + 1)
            tf = pf[13]
            rf = math.sqrt(pf[6]**2 + pf[7]**2)
            
            txf = pf[10] + rf * math.cos(tf)
            tyf = pf[11] + rf * math.sin(tf)
            tzf = pf[12] + pf[8]
            
            fxf = (txf - pf[0]) * 0.09
            fyf = (tyf - pf[1]) * 0.09
            fzf = (tzf - pf[2]) * 0.09
            pf[14] = max(0.0, pf[14] * 0.88)
            
            # Inverse Orbit
            pi[13] -= 0.025 * (pi[9] + 1)
            ti = pi[13]
            ri = math.sqrt(pi[6]**2 + pi[7]**2)
            
            txi = pi[10] - ri * math.cos(ti)
            tyi = pi[11] - ri * math.sin(ti)
            tzi = pi[12] - pi[8]
            
            fxi = (txi - pi[0]) * 0.09
            fyi = (tyi - pi[1]) * 0.09
            fzi = (tzi - pi[2]) * 0.09
            pi[14] = max(0.0, pi[14] * 0.88)
            
            # Phase-Lock Distance
            p_dist = math.sqrt((pf[0]-pi[0])**2 + (pf[1]-pi[1])**2 + (pf[2]-pi[2])**2)
            if p_dist < 20.0:
                pf[15] = min(1.0, pf[15] + 0.18)
                pi[15] = min(1.0, pi[15] + 0.18)
                total_phase_locks += 1
            else:
                pf[15] = max(0.0, pf[15] * 0.85)
                pi[15] = max(0.0, pi[15] * 0.85)
                
            # Gravity Warp
            if self.touch_pos:
                px_f, py_f, _, _ = self.project(pf[0], pf[1], pf[2])
                tdxf, tdyf = self.touch_pos.x - px_f, self.touch_pos.y - py_f
                t_distf = math.sqrt(tdxf*tdxf + tdyf*tdyf)
                if t_distf < 240 and t_distf > 1:
                    force_f = (240 - t_distf) * 0.16
                    fxf += (tdxf / t_distf) * force_f
                    fyf += (tdyf / t_distf) * force_f
                    pf[14] = min(1.0, pf[14] + force_f * 0.06)
                    
                px_i, py_i, _, _ = self.project(pi[0], pi[1], pi[2])
                tdxi, tdyi = self.touch_pos.x - px_i, self.touch_pos.y - py_i
                t_disti = math.sqrt(tdxi*tdxi + tdyi*tdyi)
                if t_disti < 240 and t_disti > 1:
                    force_i = (240 - t_disti) * 0.16
                    fxi += (tdxi / t_disti) * force_i
                    fyi += (tdyi / t_disti) * force_i
                    pi[14] = min(1.0, pi[14] + force_i * 0.06)
            
            # Verlet Integration
            pf[3] = (pf[3] + fxf) * 0.84
            pf[4] = (pf[4] + fyf) * 0.84
            pf[5] = (pf[5] + fzf) * 0.84
            pf[0] += pf[3]; pf[1] += pf[4]; pf[2] += pf[5]
            
            pi[3] = (pi[3] + fxi) * 0.84
            pi[4] = (pi[4] + fyi) * 0.84
            pi[5] = (pi[5] + fzi) * 0.84
            pi[0] += pi[3]; pi[1] += pi[4]; pi[2] += pi[5]

        # Trigger Harmonic Audio Modulation on High Phase Lock (Fixed self.t)
        curr_time = self.t
        if total_phase_locks > 12 and (curr_time - self.last_audio_time) > 0.25:
            self.last_audio_time = curr_time
            pitch_val = 1.0 + (total_phase_locks % 8) * 0.12
            sound.play_effect('digital:Laser1', volume=0.15, pitch=pitch_val)

    def update(self):
        self.angle_y += 0.007
        
        self.draw_background()
        self.update_physics_and_audio()

        # Bucket Depth Sorting
        num_buckets = 16
        buckets = [[] for _ in range(num_buckets)]
        min_z, max_z = 450.0, 1050.0
        
        # Strands
        for c1, c2 in self.strands:
            p1 = self.project(c1[0], c1[1], c1[2])
            p2 = self.project(c2[0], c2[1], c2[2])
            avg_z = (p1[2] + p2[2]) / 2
            b_idx = max(0, min(num_buckets - 1, int(((avg_z - min_z) / (max_z - min_z)) * num_buckets)))
            buckets[b_idx].append(('strand', avg_z, p1, p2))

        # Forward Particles
        for p in self.particles_fwd:
            px, py, depth, scale = self.project(p[0], p[1], p[2])
            b_idx = max(0, min(num_buckets - 1, int(((depth - min_z) / (max_z - min_z)) * num_buckets)))
            buckets[b_idx].append(('fwd_particle', depth, px, py, scale, p[9], p[14], p[15]))

        # Inverse Particles
        for p in self.particles_inv:
            px, py, depth, scale = self.project(p[0], p[1], p[2])
            b_idx = max(0, min(num_buckets - 1, int(((depth - min_z) / (max_z - min_z)) * num_buckets)))
            buckets[b_idx].append(('inv_particle', depth, px, py, scale, p[9], p[14], p[15]))
            
        # Nodes
        for cx, cy, cz in self.centers:
            px, py, depth, scale = self.project(cx, cy, cz)
            b_idx = max(0, min(num_buckets - 1, int(((depth - min_z) / (max_z - min_z)) * num_buckets)))
            buckets[b_idx].append(('node', depth, px, py, scale))

        # Render Pass
        for b in range(num_buckets - 1, -1, -1):
            for item in buckets[b]:
                kind = item[0]
                
                if kind == 'strand':
                    _, depth, p1, p2 = item
                    fog = max(0.05, min(0.35, 600 / depth))

                    r_c = r_c * (1 - plock) + 1.0 * plock
                    g_c = g_c * (1 - plock) + 1.0 * plock
                    b_c = b_c * (1 - plock) + 0.9 * plock
                    
                    dof_blur = abs(depth - 750) * 0.008
                    pt_size = (2.2 + h_idx * 0.4 + stress * 3.0 + plock * 4.0 + dof_blur) * scale
                    
                    if plock > 0.2:

                    scene.fill(r_c, g_c, b_c, depth_fog)
                    scene.ellipse(px - pt_size/2, py - pt_size/2, pt_size, pt_size)

                elif kind == 'inv_particle':
                    _, depth, px, py, scale, h_idx, stress, plock = item
